notes.title: McPixel 3 is Out Now!
notes.content:
McPixel 3! Available now! Grab it while it's hot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1338580/McPixel_3/

After over 3 years of work I am honoured to present you with this amazing sequel! 100 levels of absolute goodness! Upgraded pixel graphics, minigames, an entire city to explore and more! If you ever wished there to be more McPixel, here it is! Check out the McPixel 3 store page for more!

notes.title: Check out the brand new McPixel 3 Demo!
notes.content:
Hello, hero day savers!
Still waiting for McPixel 2? Exceeding your expectations, here's McPixel 3, coming up this year, and you can play the brand new demo of it right now!
Check it out and add it to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1338580/McPixel_3/

notes.title: McPixel X-mas Free DLC has arrived!
notes.content:
Happy Holidays everyone!

To celebrate the upcoming observances, McPixel has just received a fresh pack of Holiday themed levels! Including a Steam Sale themed level! 

Additionally, a user level pack titled Userpack D has been assembled sporting six community created McPixel levels! Make sure you check out the level creator and maybe make a level as well! It's fun!

Free DLC is free and available via the game's main menu! Just jump into the box labelled Free DLC in the Main Menu screen and enjoy over 60 absolutely free additional McPixel levels!

And on top of that, McPixel is currently on sale and you can get it for only one dollar!

Happy Holidays and everything else!
Cheers!
- Sos
